[Verse]
I woke up this mornin', devil was callin' my name  
Crossroads wind was whisperin', never leave me the same  
My heart's got a hole, baby, burned by a flame  
Lookin' for redemption, but it ain't no easy game  

[Chorus]

Playin' on six strings, tryin' to make me whole  
Every note a confession, every tear a toll

Playin' on six strings, tryin' to make me whole  
Every note a confession, every tear a toll  
Singin' for salvation as I lose control  

[Outro]
Sun's risin' slowly, but the pain stays near  
Carryin' these blues down a lonesome frontier

## Local prompt writer
Type your song idea in the **Local LLM** node (replace the text after "My Topic/Requirement"). Qwen 3.5 2B writes style tags and lyrics, split at `---`, and ACE-Step 1.5 turbo renders the song. Fits a 16 GB GPU: ComfyUI unloads the LLM before the ACE-Step render when VRAM is tight.

Guide: [Subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph)

## Model Links

- [Hugging Face:Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files)

**ModelScope mirrors** (alternative repo location)

- [ModelScope:Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files](https://modelscope.cn/models/Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3.5_2b_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3.5_2b_bf16.safetensors) (4.5 GB): local LLM that writes the tags and lyrics (replaces the paid Gemini API node)
- [qwen_0.6b_ace15.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_0.6b_ace15.safetensors) (1.11 GB)
- [qwen_4b_ace15.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_4b_ace15.safetensors) (7.8 GB)

**vae**

- [ace_1.5_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ace_1.5_vae.safetensors) (321.8 MB)

**diffusion_models**

- [acestep_v1.5_turbo.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/acestep_v1.5_turbo.safetensors) (4.46 GB)

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   ├── qwen_0.6b_ace15.safetensors
│   │   ├── qwen_4b_ace15.safetensors
│   │   └── qwen3.5_2b_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── ace_1.5_vae.safetensors
│   └── 📂 diffusion_models/
│       └── acestep_v1.5_turbo.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud will be updated after the stable release; nightly-supported models may not be included yet, please wait for the next stable release.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

widgets_values:
**Role:** You are a professional Music Architect for **ACE-Step 1.5**. 

**Task:** Generate a music creation plan.

**Strict Output Constraint (IMPORTANT):**
1. Return the output as **RAW PLAIN TEXT** only.
2. DO NOT use Markdown code blocks (no backticks ```).
3. DO NOT use any headers, labels, or bold text.
4. Use ONLY the separator `---` to divide the two parts.
5. Part 1: Comma-separated style keywords.
6. Part 2: Structured lyrics with [Tags].

**My Topic/Requirement:**
A blues song, to rival the great Robert Johnson.
